desc: Ideation: identify compression + tiny-B sliding window structure
Prove crossing lemma: for A < B, a bad interval of length >= B forces "No" (min crossing jump = len+1 > B); len = B-1 remains crossable

Prove saturation cap: in an all-good gap the first reachable offset is <= B-1, and from any reachable x all positions >= x + A*ceil((A-1)/(B-A)) are reachable (conductor of semigroup generated by {A..B}); hence C = T + 2B guarantees the last B positions of any capped gap match the original (all-ones iff any reachable, else all-zero), so capping preserves the DP state that affects the future
Final-gap rule: if final gap length > C, answer = any reachable square in the retained prefix (first reachable entry is within B squares, and N >= entry + T); else exact f[N]

Implement full solution: (1) A==B via (N-1)%d==0 and no bad square ≡1 mod d; (2) A<B with len>=B rejection, coordinate compression capping every good gap at C, sliding-window DP over [x-B, x-A], output f[last] or any(reachable[final_start:])
Brute-force validate against exhaustive O(N) DP on small random N, M, A, B, emphasizing bad-interval boundaries, first-reachable-offset-late cases, and truncated vs exact final gaps
Check edge cases and performance: M=0, N=2, A=1, A=19/B=20 (worst C=382, compressed length ~8e6, runtime acceptable), adjacent disjoint intervals
**A==B case**: reachable set is exactly {1+kd}; modular check with `first = l + ((residue-l) % d)` correctly detects any bad square ≡1 (mod d). Handles d=1 correctly (any bad square → No).

**Crossing lemma**: merged touching intervals (input allows R_i+1 = L_{i+1}); block length ≥ B needs jump ≥ len+1 > B → correctly rejected. This also bounds bad-block representation to ≤19 cells each.

**Saturation**: sums of k jumps fill [kA, kB]; intervals chain once k(B-A) ≥ A-1, so every offset ≥ T = A·⌈(A-1)/(B-A)⌉ is representable. First reachable square in a gap is within B squares (else window lies entirely in an unreachable gap prefix). Thus last B cells of any gap longer than C = T+2B are all-ones (or all-zeros), and window counts for positions after the gap match between original and compressed boards — compression is sound.

**Final gap**: for length > C, N's window lies inside the saturated region, so N reachable ⟺ any reachable cell in the retained prefix; the retained prefix DP is exact since the board prefix is identical.
**DP recurrence**: window [x-B, x-A] maintained with entering = x-A, leaving = x-B-1; verified at boundaries (x=2, A=1, B=1,2).
